messages:
anya: Quick question — can we lock down the SI co-sell gating rules before the marketplace push next week? Need clear handoff and demo responsibilities.
chris-m: Yes. Primary ask: define lead ownership, claim window, and what triggers a handoff to SI. Also how marketplace listings influence priority.
roberto: Draft proposal — 1) Lead ARR >= 50k => auto-route to SI queue. 2) Product = Private or Regulated => require pre-demo security check. 3) If customer requests on-prem, tag as SI-high.
emma-w: +1. For claim window: 72h for primary AE to claim, then auto-assign to SI-ops for triage. We should record claim using CRM tag: SI_CLAIMED:true and SI_OWNER:<user>.
anya: Where does the marketplace lead feed sit? If listing comes from marketplace, do we treat it as inbound SDR or SI-intake?
roberto: Marketplace leads = inbound SDR by default. But if metadata includes partner_id or hw_partner flag, escalate to SI triage immediately. See example tag format: marketplace_meta:partner_id=atlasone;hw_partner=true;lead_weight=0.8
chris-m: Can we add a simple routing rule in the intake lambda? Pseudocode: ```if (lead.ARR >= 50000 || lead.tags.includes('hw_partner')) routeTo('si-triage') else routeTo('sdr-queue')```
maya-eng: I can drop that into the intake function. Will add a feature flag so we can test in staging first. Also adding a short webhook payload to include partner metadata: {"partner_id":"string","hw_partner":"bool","origin":"marketplace"}
emma-w: Ops note: SI should have a weekly pulse channel for claimed leads: #si-claimed-pulse. Post format: "<date> | Lead <acct> | ARR:<n> | Owner:<user> | Status:<stage>"
anya: For joint announcements, require product + marketing pre-approval before scheduling demos. Add a simple checklist: 1) NDA/PO signed? 2) Security review for private deployments? 3) Joint messaging doc in drive?
roberto: Escalation matrix: AE -> SI-ops -> Partnerships -> Legal. Tag escalation in CRM with escalation:true and escalate_to:<team>.
partner-integrations-bot: New marketplace listing detected: atlasone-gpu-accelerated-v1 — lead_endpoint: https://redwood.example/leads/8472
chris-m: That bot post should trigger a triage ticket if hw_partner=true. Can we wire that?
maya-eng: Yes, will add mapping: bot payload => create ticket in si-triage with tags from payload. Pls confirm required fields: account_name, contact_email, ARR_estimate, partner_id, hw_partner(boolean).
emma-w: Confirmed. Also adding a lightweight demo playbook template to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/company/si/demo-playbook (short checklist + joint slidedeck template).
anya: Solid. Last ask — can we set an SLA: triage ack within 4 business hours for marketplace hw_partner leads? Want SLAs before launch.
roberto: 4h ack seems reasonable for NA hours. We'll note timezone caveat. I'll file a follow-up to negotiations for SLA in contract templates.
chris-m: Thanks everyone. Next step: maya to push staging flag, roberto to publish gating doc, emma to create pulse channel and demo playbook. I'll loop in legal once gating doc is ready. :thumbsup:
